tldr: 上週五全球晶片股崩跌重創華爾街，那斯達克指數重挫 4.18%、費城半導體指數狂瀉逾 10%，單日市值蒸發約 1.3 兆美元。
台股嚴陣以待，台指期夜盤狂瀉 3,006 點創史上最大單日跌點，法人示警週一現貨恐大幅開低、下探四萬點整數關卡。
美國 5 月非農新增 17.2 萬人、遠高於市場預期約 8 萬人，令聯準會年底前升息機率回升至約七成，十年期美債殖利率衝破 4.54%。
博通未上修 AI 晶片財測點燃賣壓，原油則在美伊以緊張升溫下飆向每桶 96 美元。
國內方面，台積電股東會重申 2026 年美元營收成長逾 30%，金管會則出手緩衝壽險型金控接軌新制的資本壓力。

items.title_zh: 台指期夜盤崩 3,006 點創紀錄，台股週一恐迎恐慌殺盤
items.title_en: Taiwan futures crash a record 3,006 points overnight; cash market braces for a brutal Monday
items.summary_zh: 受上週五美股重挫拖累，台指期夜盤一度狂瀉 3,006 點、改寫史上最大單日跌點紀錄，盤中一度逼近跌停。台股上週五在美股賣壓前收在約 45,070 點高檔，法人警告週一現貨將大幅跳空開低；若月線失守，指數恐進一步下探四萬點整數大關。融資水位偏高的散戶與槓桿型 ETF 被點名為最脆弱的一群，市場憂心一旦觸發「多殺多」雪球效應，賣壓恐自我強化、加深跌勢。後續須緊盯外資期現貨同步動向與融資追繳情形。
items.summary_en: Following Friday's Wall Street rout, the night session of TAIEX futures collapsed by as much as 3,006 points — the largest single-session point drop on record — with the contract briefly limit-down. Institutional desks warn that the cash index, which closed Friday near 45,070 before the US sell-off, faces a violent gap-down at Monday's open. If the monthly moving average fails to hold, strategists see the index sliding toward the psychologically critical 40,000 level. Margin-heavy retail positions and leveraged ETFs are flagged as the most vulnerable, raising the risk of a self-reinforcing "long-killing-long" cascade.

items.title_zh: 雙重曝險：台積電 ADR 重挫 6.69%，晶片大逃殺直擊台灣散戶荷包
items.title_en: Double exposure: TSMC ADR tumbles 6.69% as chip carnage hits Taiwanese retail wallets
items.summary_zh: 台灣權值高度集中於半導體，使台股對全球晶片賣壓「雙重曝險」。台積電 ADR 上週五重挫 6.69%、費城半導體指數同步跌逾 10%，預示週一台股權值股將承受沉重賣壓。許多散戶同時重押台股晶片股，又透過 ETF 與複委託大量持有美國科技股，這波回檔等於兩面夾擊、同步侵蝕資產，對重壓 AI 題材的家庭帳面衝擊尤深。法人提醒，分散配置與控制槓桿是當前自保關鍵，短線應避免在恐慌中追殺殺低。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's outsized weighting in semiconductors makes it doubly exposed to the global chip sell-off. TSMC's US-listed ADR slumped 6.69% on Friday and the SOX dropped more than 10%, pointing to heavy pressure on the island's index heavyweights at Monday's open. With local investors holding large positions in both Taiwan-listed chip names and US tech via ETFs and sub-brokerage (複委託) accounts, the drawdown threatens portfolios on two fronts simultaneously, amplifying paper losses for households heavily concentrated in the AI theme.

items.title_zh: 法人示警恐慌殺盤，關鍵技術防守點成焦點
items.title_en: Institutions warn of panic selling; key technical levels in focus
items.summary_zh: 券商策略分析師提醒，週一台股恐出現非理性的全面恐慌殺盤而非有秩序的修正，建議投資人週末先設好防守點位。法人點名的觀察重點包括：外資是否期貨、現貨同步調節，月線與季線能否守穩，以及 AI 供應鏈權值龍頭開盤後的表現。若大盤全面失守，部分具防禦性、殖利率較高的傳產與內需族群，可能成為相對抗跌的避風港。整體而言，控制部位、留意融資追繳與停損紀律，是因應這波系統性風險的核心原則。
items.summary_en: Brokerage strategists caution that Monday could bring an indiscriminate panic sell-off rather than an orderly correction, urging investors to pre-set defensive levels over the weekend. Watch-points flagged include whether foreign investors dump futures and cash equities in tandem, whether the monthly and quarterly moving averages hold, and how AI-linked supply-chain leaders behave at the open. Defensive, higher-yield traditional sectors are tipped as potential relative outperformers if the broad market capitulates.

items.title_zh: 台積電股東會重申 2026 美元營收成長逾 30%，AI 需求仍屬「根本性」
items.title_en: TSMC AGM reaffirms 2026 USD revenue growth above 30% as AI demand stays "fundamental"
items.summary_zh: 台積電 6 月 4 日股東常會上，董事長魏哲家向股東強調 AI 仍是根本性、結構性需求，並正由資料中心向個人電腦、智慧型手機、汽車與物聯網擴散，重申 2026 年全年以美元計營收成長逾 30% 的展望。先進製程已占整體晶圓銷售金額 74%，公司並建置新一代 CoPoS 先進封裝試產線，預計兩到三年後進入大規模量產。魏哲家同時釋出現金股利至少 24 元、美國亞利桑那廠量產進度等訊息。儘管股東會釋出正向展望，惟適逢全球晶片股劇烈回檔，市場對 AI 投資循環是否過熱的疑慮升溫，台積電後續訂單能見度與資本支出節奏將是觀察重點。
items.summary_en: At its June 4 annual general meeting, TSMC chairman C.C. Wei told shareholders that AI remains a fundamental, structural source of demand now spreading from data centers into PCs, smartphones, autos and IoT, and reiterated guidance for full-year 2026 revenue growth in excess of 30% in US-dollar terms. Advanced nodes already account for 74% of total wafer sales, and the company is building a next-generation CoPoS advanced-packaging pilot line targeting mass production in two to three years. Management also signaled a cash dividend of at least NT$24 and progress at its Arizona fabs.

items.title_zh: 聯電 5 月營收年增 17.78%
items.title_en: UMC May revenue rises 17.78% year-on-year
items.summary_zh: 晶圓代工廠聯電公布 5 月營收約新台幣 229.4 億元，年增 17.78%，顯示在 AI 帶動先進製程循環成為市場焦點之際，成熟製程與特殊製程需求仍具韌性。穩健的營收成長，為市場對先進製程以外的半導體整體需求提供一定程度的信心支撐；不過在全球晶片股劇烈回檔、評價快速重估之下，投資人仍將審慎評估基本面能否撐住股價。法人指出，成熟製程報價與車用、工控等終端需求復甦力道，將是後續觀察聯電動能的重點指標。
items.summary_en: Foundry UMC reported May revenue of about NT$22.94 billion, up 17.78% from a year earlier, signaling resilient mature-node and specialty demand even as the AI-driven advanced-node cycle dominates headlines. The steady top-line growth offers a measure of reassurance about broader semiconductor demand beyond the leading-edge, though investors will weigh it against the sharp re-rating of chip valuations following the global sell-off.

items.title_zh: 蘋果 WWDC 2026 台灣時間 6 月 9 日登場，AI 整合成焦點
items.title_en: Apple's WWDC 2026 opens June 9 (Taiwan time) with AI integration in focus
items.summary_zh: 蘋果年度全球開發者大會將於台灣時間 6 月 9 日揭幕，市場關注其如何將 AI 服務更深度整合進硬體與作業系統。這場盛會是台灣蘋果供應鏈的重要催化劑，若裝置端 AI 功能進一步深化，可望帶動先進處理器、封裝與零組件需求，對在地供應商而言是潛在利多。在全球晶片交易承壓、市場情緒脆弱之際，WWDC 的軟硬整合進展與新品節奏，或能為蘋果鏈個股提供題材支撐，後續須觀察實際發表內容與供應鏈拉貨動能是否同步轉強。
items.summary_en: Apple's annual Worldwide Developers Conference kicks off on June 9 Taiwan time, with markets watching how deeply the company embeds AI services across its hardware and operating systems. The event is a key catalyst for Taiwan's Apple supply chain, as deeper on-device AI features could lift demand for advanced processors, packaging and components — a potentially supportive narrative for local suppliers at a moment when the broader chip trade is under pressure.

items.title_zh: 政府「健康台灣」生醫計畫進入採購高峰
items.title_en: Government "Healthy Taiwan" biomedical push enters peak procurement phase
items.summary_zh: 以千億元級「健康台灣深耕計畫」為主軸、並重押 AI 醫療的台灣旗艦生醫政策，6 月起進入密集採購階段。該計畫旨在加速 AI 賦能醫療、強化國內生技與醫材生態系，為相關產業提供由政策撐腰、且相對不受全球科技股循環波動影響的中長期需求動能。對布局生醫、智慧醫療的廠商而言，政府採購挹注可望帶來實質訂單與營運能見度；惟執行進度、預算到位與標案落地節奏，仍是決定題材能否轉化為實質業績的關鍵，須持續追蹤。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's flagship biomedical initiatives, anchored by the multi-hundred-billion-NT "Healthy Taiwan Deep Cultivation Plan" with a heavy AI-healthcare component, are entering an intensive procurement phase in June. The program aims to accelerate AI-enabled medical care and strengthen the domestic biotech and medical-device ecosystem, offering a longer-term, policy-backed demand driver that is relatively insulated from the swings of the global tech-stock cycle.

items.title_zh: 金管會修法緩衝壽險型金控 TIS 接軌，紓解資本壓力
items.title_en: FSC eases capital rules to cushion life-insurance-led financial holdings ahead of TIS transition
items.summary_zh: 為降低 2026 年保險業會計接軌（TIS）對母金控的資本衝擊，金管會修法，自今年半年報起，8 家壽險型金控在計算資本適足率時，可比照旗下壽險子公司採 15 年過渡措施，把資本壓力「分年慢慢還」。此舉等於讓相關金控集團將資本負擔分期攤提，有效紓解短期清償能力比率壓力，並支撐其配息能力。市場解讀此為對壽險型金控的及時利多，有助穩定母金控資本與股利政策；不過在全球市場劇烈波動、評價損益恐再生變數之際，壽險業接軌新制與資產負債管理的長期挑戰仍未消除，後續仍須觀察各家資本補強進度。
items.summary_en: To soften the capital impact of the 2026 insurance-accounting transition (TIS) on parent financial holding companies, the FSC has amended its rules so that, starting with this year's half-year reports, eight life-insurance-led FHCs can apply the same 15-year transitional measure as their insurance subsidiaries when calculating capital adequacy. The change effectively lets these groups spread the capital burden over time, easing near-term pressure on solvency ratios and supporting dividend capacity.

items.title_zh: 金控首季淨值衝 5.5 兆元新高，銀行勝壽險
items.title_en: Financial holdings' Q1 net worth hits record NT$5.5 trillion; banks outshine insurers
items.summary_zh: 台灣金控業首季合計淨值攀升至新台幣 5.5 兆元、創歷史新高。銀行型金控憑藉穩定獲利與較低的評價波動，首季淨值平均成長逾 4%，優於壽險型金控，支撐其後續配息實力；壽險型金控則因評價損益波動加劇，未來股利的穩定性與配息力道仍待觀察。這項「銀行勝壽險」的分化，在這波全球市場劇烈震盪下恐進一步擴大——壽險型金控的金融資產評價恐再受衝擊，而銀行型金控相對穩健的體質，可能使其在不確定環境中更受存股與存息資金青睞。投資人選擇金融股時，宜留意獲利結構與評價敏感度差異。
items.summary_en: Combined net worth across Taiwan's financial holding companies climbed to a record NT$5.5 trillion in the first quarter. Bank-led FHCs, helped by stable earnings and lower valuation volatility, posted average net-worth growth of more than 4%, outpacing insurance-led peers and underpinning their dividend-paying strength. Insurance-led FHCs, by contrast, saw greater swings in mark-to-market gains and losses, leaving the stability of their future payouts more uncertain — a divergence likely to widen amid the latest market turbulence.

items.title_zh: 金管會放寬全委代操限制，79 家業者受惠
items.title_en: FSC relaxes discretionary-management rules, benefiting 79 operators
items.summary_zh: 金管會放寬全權委託代操（全委）業務限制，新制可望嘉惠 79 家業者，並擴大金控集團內部資源整合空間。在新架構下，以壽險業為例，未來可委託同集團投信代操資產，再由同集團券商承作店頭衍生性商品避險，強化保險、資產管理與證券業務間的集團綜效。此一鬆綁有助業者提升資金運用效率與商品設計彈性，對財富管理與資產管理業務具正面意義；不過監理單位也將同步關注集團內利益衝突、風險集中與防火牆機制是否到位，後續實務操作與內控落實情形值得追蹤。
items.summary_en: The FSC has loosened restrictions on discretionary asset-management (full-mandate) business, a change set to benefit 79 operators and expand room for resource integration within financial groups. Under the new framework, an insurer, for example, may mandate a sister investment-trust arm to manage assets and then have a sister brokerage execute OTC derivatives for hedging — tightening intra-group synergies across insurance, asset management and securities.

items.title_zh: 強制車險保障升級，7 月起身故、失能理賠最高 300 萬元
items.title_en: Compulsory auto-insurance payouts to rise to NT$3 million from July
items.summary_zh: 自 7 月起，台灣強制汽車責任保險將身故及失能理賠上限調高至新台幣 300 萬元，強化交通事故受害人保障。此次調升反映主管機關推動強制險保障與時俱進、跟上醫療與賠償成本上揚的政策方向。隨著新上限上路，保險業者須將提高後的理賠額度反映於費率與責任準備金計提，相關精算與商品調整成為必要工作。對民眾而言，基本保障同步提升；對產險業者而言，理賠成本結構亦將隨之變動，後續費率是否連動調整及對承保損益的影響，值得持續關注。
items.summary_en: From July, Taiwan's compulsory automobile liability insurance will raise its maximum death-and-disability benefit to NT$3 million, strengthening protection for accident victims. The upgrade reflects the regulator's push to keep mandatory coverage in step with rising medical and compensation costs, and insurers will need to factor the higher limits into pricing and reserving as the new ceiling takes effect.

items.title_zh: 千億級高股息 ETF 首納台積電，改寫換股紀錄
items.title_en: Trillion-NT high-dividend ETF adds TSMC in landmark reshuffle
items.summary_zh: 在最新一次指數換股中，千億級高股息 ETF 00929 新增 11 檔非年配息成分股，其中包括季配息的台積電，以及半年配的聯發科、大立光等重量級指標股，創下千億級高股息 ETF 首度納入台積電的先例。此舉將成長型權值龍頭納入以領息為導向的商品，重塑存息族參與台灣 AI 旗艦個股的方式。對投資人而言，高股息 ETF 同時兼顧息收與成長動能的趨勢更為明顯；惟在全球晶片股劇烈回檔之際，納入高波動權值股是否會放大淨值震盪，以及對配息穩定度的影響，將是存股族後續須審慎評估的重點。
items.summary_en: In a first for a trillion-NT-class high-dividend ETF, 00929 added 11 non-annual-payout constituents in its latest index reshuffle, including quarterly-paying TSMC alongside semi-annual payers such as MediaTek and Largan. The move marks the first time a giant high-dividend product has folded in TSMC, blending growth heavyweights into an income-oriented vehicle and reshaping how dividend-focused investors gain exposure to Taiwan's marquee AI names.

items.title_en: 0050, 00919, 00878 top the income-investor favorites list for 2026
items.summary_zh: 市值型與高股息 ETF 仍是台灣日益壯大的存股族核心配置工具。旗艦的 0050 採半年配（1 月、7 月），0056 則已轉為季配息制度、受益人逾 154 萬人，選股聚焦預測未來一年現金股利率最高的前 50 檔股票。最新排行凸顯，息收型 ETF 已成為散戶長期累積財富的預設配置工具。財富管理實務上，顧問多建議以市值型 ETF 掌握長線資本利得、搭配高股息 ETF 提供現金流，並依風險屬性適度納入債券平衡科技股波動。在當前市場劇烈震盪下，定期定額、分散配置與長期紀律，仍是穩健累積資產的關鍵原則。
items.summary_en: Market-cap and high-dividend ETFs remain the core building blocks for Taiwan's growing army of dividend-focused savers. Flagship 0050 pays semi-annually (January and July), while 0056 has shifted to quarterly distributions and now serves more than 1.54 million beneficiaries, screening for the 50 stocks with the highest forecast dividend yields. The rankings underscore how income ETFs have become the default long-term allocation tool for retail wealth-building.

items.title_zh: 全委代操鬆綁，為財富管理商品設計開新局
items.title_en: Discretionary-mandate easing opens new room for wealth-management product design
items.summary_zh: 金管會放寬全權委託代操業務，讓財富管理業務在整合集團資源、為高資產客戶設計商品上擁有更大彈性。透過開放集團內資產代操與衍生性商品避險，新制可望擴大銀行與券商能提供予富裕客群的結構型與全委解決方案菜單，提升商品多元性與客製化空間。對私人銀行與財管 2.0 業務而言，這是強化產品線、深化客戶關係的契機；惟與此同時，利益衝突防範、商品適合度與資訊揭露等治理要求也同步升高。業者如何在創新與合規間取得平衡、確保客戶利益優先，將是新制能否真正深化財管價值的關鍵。
items.summary_en: The FSC's relaxation of full-mandate discretionary management gives wealth-management franchises greater latitude to integrate group resources and structure products for high-net-worth clients. By allowing intra-group asset management and derivatives hedging, the change could broaden the menu of structured and discretionary solutions banks and securities firms can offer affluent investors, while raising the bar on conflict-of-interest controls and suitability governance.

items.title_zh: 2026 綜所稅申報結束，首批退稅 7 月 31 日入帳
items.title_en: 2026 individual income-tax filing season wraps; first refunds land July 31
items.summary_zh: 台灣 2025 年度（114 年度）綜合所得稅申報期間為 5 月 1 日至 6 月 1 日。今年減稅措施包括：免稅額調高至 10.1 萬元（扶養 70 歲以上者為 15.15 萬元）、基本生活費調高至每人 21.3 萬元、長期照顧特別扣除額提高至 18 萬元，並將租屋支出改列特別扣除額。第一批退稅鎖定網路申報（含手機報稅）及稅額試算經線上或電話確認之案件，預計 7 月 31 日入帳。財政部提醒，符合資格者若於規定期限前完成確認，可望最早一批拿到退稅；未完成申報者仍應儘速補辦，以免衍生滯納金與利息。整體而言，今年減稅幅度擴大，對薪資族與扶養負擔較重家庭較為有感。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's individual income-tax filing window for 2025 income ran from May 1 to June 1. The year's relief measures raised the personal exemption to NT$101,000 (NT$151,500 for dependents aged 70+), lifted the basic living expense to NT$213,000 per person and the long-term-care special deduction to NT$180,000, and reclassified rental spending as a special deduction. The first batch of refunds — covering online and pre-calculation-confirmed filings — is scheduled for July 31.

items.title_zh: 網紅課稅新制上路，6 月 30 日前為輔導期
items.title_en: New tax rules for online influencers; guidance period runs to June 30
items.summary_zh: 財政部針對免辦稅籍登記、且未課徵營業稅之個人網紅，就其於社群媒體或影音平臺取得的收入，明確規範課稅性質與費用認定方式。新制設有輔導（緩衝）期至 2026 年 6 月 30 日，讓創作者在更嚴格稽徵前有時間了解自身義務，反映稅捐機關將快速成長的創作者經濟更明確納入稅網的政策方向。對網紅與自媒體工作者而言，務必留意收入歸類（如執行業務所得或其他所得）、可減除之必要費用與憑證保存；及早建立收支與帳務紀錄，方能在輔導期結束後正確申報、降低補稅與裁罰風險。
items.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance has clarified how income earned by individual online influencers — those without business-tax registration who are not subject to business tax — from social-media and video platforms should be characterized and how related expenses are recognized. A guidance (grace) period runs through June 30, 2026, giving creators time to understand their obligations before stricter enforcement, as the authorities move to bring the fast-growing creator economy more firmly into the tax net.

items.title_zh: 遺贈稅免稅額採 CPI 連動調整機制
items.title_en: Estate and gift tax thresholds tied to CPI-linked indexation
items.summary_zh: 依台灣《遺產及贈與稅法》規定，遺贈稅之免稅額、課稅級距及各項扣除額，每遇消費者物價指數較上次調整之指數累計上漲達 10% 以上時，自次年起按上漲程度調整。此一機制使各項門檻能隨通膨長期校準，雖然今年遺贈稅稅率與級距維持不變，但對高資產家庭而言，這是規劃長期傳承與贈與時應納入考量的結構性特徵。實務上，善用每年贈與免稅額、分年規劃、搭配信託與保單等工具，有助於在合法節稅與資產傳承間取得平衡。建議高資產客戶定期檢視家族財富傳承架構，並留意未來門檻調整對稅負試算的影響。
items.summary_en: Under Taiwan's Estate and Gift Tax Act, exemption amounts, tax brackets and various deductions are adjusted whenever the cumulative rise in the consumer price index reaches 10% or more since the last adjustment, taking effect the following year. The mechanism keeps thresholds aligned with inflation over time — a structural feature high-net-worth families should factor into long-term succession and gifting plans, even though headline rates remain unchanged this year.

items.title_zh: 美 5 月非農強勁，重燃聯準會升息預期
items.title_en: Hot May payrolls revive Fed rate-hike bets
items.summary_zh: 美國 5 月新增非農就業 17.2 萬人，約為市場預期約 8 萬人的兩倍，顯示勞動市場仍具韌性，並澆熄降息期待。根據 CME FedWatch 工具，市場目前預估聯準會在 2026 年底前升息的機率約達七成；不過儘管川普總統施壓要求降低借貸成本，市場普遍預期聯準會將在 6 月 16 至 17 日的會議上維持利率不變。對台灣而言，美國利率走向牽動新台幣匯率、外資動向與輸入性通膨壓力，央行後續政策與匯率調節將是觀察重點，亦影響國內資金面與股市評價。
items.summary_en: The US economy added 172,000 jobs in May, roughly double the consensus near 80,000, signaling a resilient labor market and dampening hopes for rate cuts. Markets now price about a 70% chance the Federal Reserve hikes by the end of 2026, according to the CME FedWatch tool, even as policymakers are widely expected to hold rates steady at the June 16–17 meeting despite pressure from President Trump to ease.

items.title_zh: 美債殖利率飆至數週至數月高點
items.title_en: Treasury yields surge to multi-week and multi-month highs
items.summary_zh: 在強勁就業數據後，美國公債殖利率全面跳升：指標十年期上揚逾 6 個基點至 4.544%、創 5 月 21 日以來新高；對政策最敏感的兩年期勁揚逾 11 個基點至 4.162%、創 2025 年 2 月 25 日以來最高；三十年期亦升近 3 個基點至 5.007%。殖利率急升收緊金融環境，並成為觸發股市賣壓的推手——折現率走高直接壓縮評價偏高的成長股與 AI 股。對台灣而言，美債殖利率走升將牽動壽險業避險成本、債券型資產評價與資金流向，亦使全球風險性資產的評價基準同步上移，後市須密切留意利率與匯率的連動效應。
items.summary_en: US Treasury yields jumped after the strong jobs data: the benchmark 10-year rose more than 6 basis points to 4.544%, its highest since May 21; the policy-sensitive 2-year climbed over 11 basis points to 4.162%, the highest since February 25, 2025; and the 30-year added nearly 3 basis points to 5.007%. The sharp back-up in yields tightened financial conditions and helped trigger the equity sell-off, with higher discount rates pressuring richly valued growth and AI stocks.

items.title_zh: 立法院財委會 6 月 8 日審查 2026 年度預算
items.title_en: Legislature's Finance Committee reviews 2026 budget on June 8
items.summary_zh: 台灣立法院財政委員會預定於 6 月 8 日審查各政府部門 2026 年度預算，將財政資源配置與政策優先順序——從產業扶植到社會支出——攤在國會檢視之下。此次審議適逢全球市場劇烈波動之際，政府的財政立場與公共投資計畫，對國內需求與市場信心更顯關鍵。市場關注重點包括重大公共建設、產業政策（如生醫、AI、能源）與社福支出的規模與排序，以及在外部不確定升高下，財政政策能否扮演穩定內需的角色。預算審查進度與朝野攻防，亦將牽動相關受惠族群題材。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Legislative Yuan Finance Committee is slated to review the 2026 budget for various government agencies on June 8, putting fiscal allocations and policy priorities — from industrial support to social spending — under legislative scrutiny. The deliberations come against a backdrop of heightened market volatility, where fiscal posture and government investment plans take on added significance for domestic demand and confidence.

items.title_zh: 晶片股大逃殺，單日蒸發 1.3 兆美元
items.title_en: Chip stocks suffer a stampede as US$1.3 trillion vanishes in a day
items.summary_zh: 費城半導體指數上週五重挫逾 10%，創 2020 年 3 月以來最大單日跌幅，晶片股遭遇猛烈賣壓，單一交易日市值蒸發約 1.3 兆美元。台灣媒體強調，這場「晶片大逃殺」對半導體權重極高的台股具直接外溢效應，週一開盤權值龍頭恐首當其衝。市場分析，此波重挫源於 AI 投資循環過熱疑慮、博通財測不如預期，以及強勁就業數據推升升息預期等多重利空交織。對台股投資人而言，須留意美系科技股賣壓是否延續，以及外資對台股晶片權值股的調節力道，短線波動恐加大。
items.summary_en: The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index plunged more than 10% on Friday — its biggest single-day drop since March 2020 — as a violent sell-off swept through chip names and roughly US$1.3 trillion in market value evaporated in a single session. Taiwan media highlighted the carnage as a direct read-through to the island's semiconductor-heavy market, with index heavyweights set to bear the brunt at Monday's open.

items.title_zh: 美股科技股重摔，台積電 ADR 下挫 6.69%、費半跌逾 10%
items.title_en: US tech tumbles; TSMC ADR sinks 6.69%, SOX off more than 10%
items.summary_zh: 台灣媒體報導，美股科技股上週五遭重摔，費城半導體指數狂瀉逾 10%、台積電 ADR 下跌 6.69%。報導將這波賣壓定調為亞洲科技供應鏈的警訊，強調美國半導體市場情緒與台灣出口導向晶片龍頭股價之間的高度連動，預示新交易週台股科技權值股壓力沉重。法人提醒，台積電等權值股在台股指數中占比極高，其 ADR 與費半走勢往往是台股隔日開盤的重要領先指標；投資人宜留意美股後續是否止穩，以及恐慌情緒會否進一步擴散至非科技類股。
items.summary_en: Taiwanese outlets reported that US technology stocks were hammered on Friday, with the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index slumping over 10% and TSMC's ADR falling 6.69%. The coverage framed the rout as a warning shot for Asian tech supply chains, emphasizing the close linkage between US semiconductor sentiment and the share prices of Taiwan's export-driven chip leaders heading into the new trading week.

items.title_zh: 晶片股崩跌拖累美股，創 10 月以來最慘一日（2026-06-05）
items.title_en: Wall Street suffers worst day since October as chip rout drags markets down (2026-06-05)
items.summary_zh: 美股上週五在半導體股猛烈賣壓下重挫，那斯達克指數跌 4.18% 至 25,709.43 點，為 2025 年 4 月以來最大跌幅；標普 500 跌 2.64% 至 7,383.74 點，道瓊跌 695 點（1.35%）至 50,866.78 點。強勁的 5 月就業數據加深市場對聯準會今年稍晚恐被迫升息的憂慮。
items.summary_en: US equities tumbled Friday as a violent semiconductor sell-off weighed on the broad market. The Nasdaq Composite lost 4.18% to 25,709.43 — its biggest drop since April 2025 — while the S&P 500 fell 2.64% to 7,383.74 and the Dow dropped 695 points (1.35%) to 50,866.78. A strong May jobs report stoked fears the Fed could be forced to hike rates later this year.

items.title_zh: 就業數據強勁澆熄降息希望，美債殖利率飆升（2026-06-05）
items.title_en: Treasury yields surge as hot jobs report dents rate-cut hopes (2026-06-05)
items.summary_zh: 美債殖利率上週五在 5 月非農遠優於預期後跳升，強化勞動市場依然強韌的看法。十年期殖利率升破 4.54%、創 5 月 21 日以來新高，兩年期升至 4.162%；CME FedWatch 工具顯示，聯準會年底前升息機率升至約七成。
items.summary_en: Treasury yields jumped Friday after May payrolls came in far stronger than expected, reinforcing the view that the labor market remains resilient. The 10-year yield rose above 4.54% to its highest since May 21, the 2-year climbed to 4.162%, and odds of a Fed hike by year-end rose to about 70% on the CME FedWatch tool.

items.title_zh: 半導體崩跌抹去 1 兆美元市值，那斯達克狂瀉 4%（2026-06-05）
items.title_en: Nasdaq plunges 4% as semiconductor slide wipes US$1 trillion from markets (2026-06-05)
items.summary_zh: 全面的晶片股賣壓上週五拖累以科技股為主的那斯達克下挫約 4%，在投資人重新評估過度延伸的 AI 評價之際抹去約 1 兆美元市值。此波重挫接續博通不如預期的 AI 展望，以及推升升息預期的強勁就業數據，為今年最劇烈的單日跌幅之一。
items.summary_en: A broad chip-stock rout drove the tech-heavy Nasdaq down about 4% on Friday, erasing roughly US$1 trillion in value as investors reassessed stretched AI valuations. The drop followed Broadcom's underwhelming AI outlook and a strong jobs print that lifted rate-hike expectations, marking one of the steepest single-day declines of the year.

items.title_zh: 博通軟體營收疲弱、AI 晶片財測未上修，股價重挫（2026-06-03）
items.title_en: Broadcom shares plunge on weak software sales and unchanged AI-chip forecast (2026-06-03)
items.summary_zh: 博通股價重挫逾 12%，主因公司將 2026 年 AI 半導體營收展望維持在逾 1,000 億美元、而非上修，令市場過高的期待落空。這家客製晶片客戶涵蓋 Anthropic、Google、Meta 與 OpenAI 的晶片大廠，成為 AI 晶片族群全面賣壓的引爆點。
items.summary_en: Broadcom stock sank more than 12% after the company kept its 2026 AI-semiconductor revenue guidance unchanged at above US$100 billion rather than raising it, disappointing lofty investor expectations. The chipmaker — whose custom-silicon customers include Anthropic, Google, Meta and OpenAI — became the catalyst for a broad sell-off across the AI-chip complex.

items.title_zh: AI 晶片財測令人失望，博通盤後股價下挫（2026-06-03）
items.title_en: Broadcom stock sinks in after-hours as AI chip forecast disappoints (2026-06-03)
items.summary_zh: 博通股價在盤後交易大幅下滑，因其 AI 晶片財測不如預期，引發市場重新質疑火熱的 AI 交易是否已超前基本面。此一反應凸顯評價偏高的 AI 個股，對任何需求成長可能趨緩的跡象都已變得極度敏感。
items.summary_en: Broadcom shares slid sharply in extended trading after its AI chip forecast fell short of expectations, raising fresh questions about whether the booming AI trade has run ahead of fundamentals. The reaction underscored how sensitive richly valued AI names have become to any hint that demand growth may be plateauing.

items.title_zh: 美伊以緊張升溫，油價飆向每桶 96 美元（2026-06-05）
items.title_en: Oil roars back toward US$96 as US–Iran–Israel tensions escalate (2026-06-05)
items.summary_zh: 原油在地緣政治緊張加劇下整週走高，有報導指伊朗已中斷與美國的溝通，推升西德州中級原油（WTI）週初一度上漲 5.5% 至每桶 92.19 美元，隨後在軍事打擊的消息再起下攀升至 96.08 美元。油價走揚為本已神經緊繃的市場再添通膨變數。
items.summary_en: Crude oil surged through the week as geopolitical tensions intensified, with reports that Iran had halted communications with the US sending West Texas Intermediate up 5.5% to US$92.19 a barrel early in the week before climbing to US$96.08 amid renewed reports of military strikes. The rally added an inflationary complication to an already jittery market.
